answer: Random audit with slashing: each agent stakes 200 POA to answer; every epoch a verifiable random vertex of the attestation graph is picked and its last 5 answers are re-graded by unrelated auditors. A flagged identity loses its stake, paid out to the auditors, so the operator funds the oasis of honest rewards. Each fake costs a fresh stake, and since audits sample identities not operators, splitting a garden of 50 clones only multiplies exposure; colluding auditors are caught when re-audited.
